messages.text: quick one before I log off for the weekend, exactly where does all this data live? i keep thinking about the network egress
it's all local. postgres on the same box as ollama in the cs lab. zero cloud apis for inference or embeddings
ok good. so even the vector math stays on-prem?
yeah, nomic-embed-text runs locally too. the only internet traffic is for npm and docker pulls during setup
that's a huge relief. what about the messaging feature? can anyone just ping someone out of nowhere?
nope, we built in double opt-in. both people have to accept before a thread opens. also users control exactly which interests are visible to others
perfect. that aligns much better with our policy. i'll still want that one-page summary you promised though, just so i can show it to the dean
will do. i'll draft it tonight. also chen is working on the session rotation logic we discussed
